newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Don Group in 31 mln rand hotel expansion.
newsitem.headline: Don Group in 31 mln rand hotel expansion.

text.p: South Arican hotels company The Don Group Ltd said on Friday it had sealed a series of deals totalling 31 million rand to expand and upgrade its hotel chains.

The group said it had bought the building housing one of its hotels in Illovo, Johannesburg, for 10.7 million rand, planned to build an eight million rand hotel in Bloemfontein and confirmed a 12.4 million rand hotel at Johannesburg's international airport.
The deals have been funded with 1.7 million rand in cash and the issue of two million new ordinary shares at 450 cents a share.
Don specialises in providing self-catering apartments for customers, who are mainly business travellers, on longer stays rather than one-bedroom full service hotels.
Earlier this month Don executives told Reuters the group was close to clinching its first overseas deal by buying a block of flats in London's fashionable Hyde Park area.
